summary: Blue Gold Ltd (Cayman Islands, metal mining, ADR on Nasdaq) filed a Form 6-K announcing the appointment of James F. Samuelson as CFO effective June 1, 2026, succeeding Lorenz Werndle who is stepping down. The appointment is a routine management succession, not abrupt or forced. Mr. Samuelson receives a $250k salary, performance bonus, 250k Class A ordinary shares vesting quarterly over three years, and LTIP options. No deal terms or special-situation catalysts; the filing merely updates a foreign private issuer's executive change.
